purpose: Static seed atlas for LLMGameCreator generator-library capabilities, feature bundles, artifact contracts, validation levels and runtime targets. This file is data-only and must not execute Lua, mutate GamePackage or generate Unity code by itself.
principles: LLM proposes, C# validates, user approves important changes, runtime executes deterministic data.
Lua modules are deterministic generators, DSL modules or IR builders, not unrestricted runtime authority.
New functionality is described as capabilities and feature bundles before it becomes C# or Unity runtime code.
Final runtime should consume compiled data and IR, not thousands of loose generated JSON files.
Adult/NSFW content is an optional content layer that may be enabled per project/profile, with explicit tags, filters and platform/export constraints. It is not a default assumption.

domains.title: Core Contracts
domains.purpose: IDs, diagnostics, schema validation, RNG and deterministic execution conventions.

capabilities.title: Canonical IDs
capabilities.summary: Lowercase slash/dot id conventions for generated data, Lua modules, capabilities and artifact contracts.

capabilities.title: Diagnostics
capabilities.summary: Standard warning/error/info records for validation and generation reports.

domains.title: Semantic Layer
domains.purpose: Entity kinds, property channels, traits, tags, state channels and semantic packs.

capabilities.title: Property Channels
capabilities.summary: Defines reusable property channels such as physical, material, social, memory, dialogue, technical, combat, magic and text_surface.

capabilities.title: Traits and State Channels
capabilities.summary: Defines traits and mutable state channels for items, NPCs, locations, factions, machines and events.

domains.title: Text, Style and Morphology
domains.purpose: Text intents, templates, speech styles, morphology IR and runtime-safe phrase plans.

capabilities.title: Text Intent Templates
capabilities.summary: Defines templates by intent, style, target entity type and selected semantic signals.

capabilities.title: Russian Morphology IR

domains.title: Dialogue and Free Text Input

capabilities.title: Choice Dialogue Graph
capabilities.summary: Node/choice dialogue with conditions, effects, quest links, faction links and validation.

capabilities.title: Free Text Dialogue NLU
capabilities.summary: Parses player free-text input into intent candidates, claims, requested actions and tone; does not mutate state directly.

domains.title: Gameplay Mechanics
domains.purpose: Reusable mechanics for items, equipment, inventory, party, stats, skills, spells, combat, economy and simulation.

capabilities.title: Paper-Doll Grid Inventory
capabilities.summary: Grid inventory with item shapes, equipment slots and paper-doll/portrait overlay bindings.

capabilities.title: Realtime / Turn-Based Hybrid Combat
capabilities.summary: Combat profile supporting realtime exploration, pause/turn/tactical combat and dialogue-combat compatibility.

capabilities.title: Party Roster
capabilities.summary: Party-based games with multiple playable characters, portraits, shared inventory and individual stats/equipment.

capabilities.title: City Builder Production and Conquest
capabilities.summary: Settlement economy, population needs, production chains, trade, military pressure and region conquest.

domains.title: Runtime Export
domains.purpose: Unity IR, runtime DB build plans, asset/audio/VFX request packs and compiled runtime data.

capabilities.title: Unity UI IR
capabilities.summary: Data-only UI screen/panel/control descriptions for Unity adapters; no direct Unity object mutation.

capabilities.title: Runtime DB Build Plan
capabilities.summary: Plan for compiling GamePackage, semantic packs, text packs and Unity IR into indexed runtime databases.

domains.title: Content Control
domains.purpose: Project-level content tags, ratings, platform filters and optional adult content layers.

capabilities.title: Content Rating and Filters
capabilities.summary: Declares project content tags and export filters, including optional adult/NSFW layers for consenting-adult content when a project enables them.
capabilities.notes: This capability does not make adult content mandatory. It makes adult content explicit, tagged, filterable and export-aware when a project enables it.

domains.title: Generator Library Growth

capabilities.title: Module Proposal Pipeline
capabilities.summary: LLM-assisted proposal of new Lua generator modules with schemas, examples and validators before human approval.

artifact_contracts.purpose: Entity kinds, property channels, traits, state channels, tags and semantic rules.

artifact_contracts.title: Text Pack
artifact_contracts.purpose: Text intents, templates, speech styles, surface variants and narrative hooks.

artifact_contracts.title: Unity IR

artifact_contracts.title: Runtime DB Build Plan

artifact_contracts.title: Content Rating Pack
artifact_contracts.purpose: Project content tags, rating declarations, export filters and optional adult-content flags.

artifact_contracts.title: Generator Library Module Proposal
artifact_contracts.purpose: Staged proposal for extending generator-library without direct unsafe commit/apply.

validation_levels.title: JSON and Schema Validation
validation_levels.purpose: Reject malformed JSON, missing required fields and invalid primitive shapes.

validation_levels.title: IDs, Enums and References
validation_levels.purpose: Reject id drift, unknown enum values, broken refs and duplicate ids.

validation_levels.title: Semantic Consistency Warnings
validation_levels.purpose: Detect suspicious material logic, unsupported content tags, lore drift and weak assumptions.

validation_levels.title: Runtime Simulation Smoke Test
validation_levels.purpose: Run deterministic headless checks for quests, combat formulas, economy loops and basic interactions.

validation_levels.title: Unity Export Dry-Run
validation_levels.purpose: Validate Unity IR and asset bindings before producing a playable Unity runtime package.

validation_levels.title: Human Approval
validation_levels.purpose: Require explicit approval for new capability domains, runtime targets, policy/content settings and important game-lore changes.
